Summary: Add automated testing (Jest) and CI pipeline (Jenkins) for Shop Pipeline Demo
Description: Add a Jest unit-test suite covering the AWS Lambda handlers (checkout, inventory validation/reservation, payment, order creation, notification), and a Jenkinsfile that runs 'npm install', 'npm test', and 'sam validate --lint' on every push, so regressions in the order-processing pipeline are caught automatically before deploy. Acceptance criteria: (1) jest runs locally via npm test and passes, (2) Jenkinsfile exists at repo root and defines Install/Test/Validate stages, (3) pipeline fails the build if any test fails.
